# model-viewer

Vendored `@google/model-viewer` 4.4.0 from its npm release.
Upstream: https://github.com/google/model-viewer
Documentation: https://modelviewer.dev/

The browser bundle is self-hosted. No CDN requests are needed for the uncompressed GLB.
